items.title: Write the focused three-tier dynamic-validation RED/GREEN execution plan
items.context: Define one canonical selector shared by validation_plan and validate; specify tier membership, impact index, stable identities, exclusion/receipt proof, fail-closed widening, rollout, acceptance evidence, and non-hard-coded inventory accounting.
items.userSees: A concise Markdown execution plan that states exactly how fast, intermediate, and full become distinct, executable, and auditable.

items.title: Obtain and resolve independent Claude CLI and Agy CLI audits
items.context: Give both CLIs the same frozen document and audit rubric; record actionable findings, reconcile conflicts against repository truth sources, revise the plan, and preserve a bounded audit record without claiming the CLIs grant lifecycle authority.
items.userSees: The final plan includes a transparent two-CLI audit disposition showing what changed and what remained unresolved.
excludes: Treating reviewer prose as signed gate evidence
Allowing either CLI to modify the repository directly
